	desc = "pmr_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes
	start_value = 0

	max_value = 26

			desc = "pmr_term_war_pressed"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				}
				value = 1

pmr_bar_defense_in_depth = {
	name = "pmr_bar_defense_in_depth"
	desc = "pmr_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes
	start_value = 0
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 26
	weekly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_pressed"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				}
				value = 1
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_enemy_has_it"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				any_enemy_in_war = {
					has_technology_researched = defense_in_depth
				}
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
}

pmr_bar_sea_lane_strategies = {
	name = "pmr_bar_sea_lane_strategies"
	desc = "pmr_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes
	start_value = 0
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 26
	weekly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_pressed"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				}
				value = 1
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_enemy_has_it"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				any_enemy_in_war = {
					has_technology_researched = sea_lane_strategies
				}
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
}

				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

pmr_bar_war_propaganda = {
	name = "pmr_bar_war_propaganda"
	desc = "pmr_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes
	start_value = 0
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 26
	weekly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_pressed"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				}
				value = 1
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "pmr_term_war_enemy_has_it"
			if = {
				limit = {
				is_at_war = yes
				pmr_mob_share >= 0.5
				OR = {
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
					}
				}
					any_scope_war = {
					any_scope_front = {
						any_scope_general = {
							owner = ROOT
							count >= 2
							num_mobilized_battalions >= 50
						}
					}
				}
				}
				any_enemy_in_war = {
					has_technology_researched = war_propaganda
				}
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
}
